title: Turk
content: We walked down to the farm yesterday, and Turk, the Belgian draft horse, was in a calm mood. He had eaten his morning hay, and stood quietly at the edge of the paddock with the other draft horses, looking across the pond.He still has a thick winter coat, and like all the animals on the farm, appreciates a good brushing this time of year.For this impromptu portrait, I usedwatercolor pencils, black and clearwater brushes, and a littlegouachein awatercolor sketchbook.
